en: She argued that the concept of philosophical liberalism as defended by Kant Rawls and Dworkin holds that the state must be neutral between different conceptions of the good life that political principles must be justifiable to all citizens regardless of their comprehensive moral or religious doctrines and that this commitment to neutrality or public reason generates the liberal framework of equal rights and fair procedures rather than substantive visions of the good.

en: He argued that the concept of Hume's problem of induction holds that inductive reasoning which infers general conclusions from particular observations cannot be rationally justified since any justification would itself be either inductive and thus circular or deductive and thus unable to support ampliative conclusions about the unobserved and that this sceptical challenge to induction has generated extensive philosophical literature including Goodman's new riddle of induction and Popper's falsificationist response.

hint: Il a soutenu que le concept de sagesse philosophique comme télos de la recherche philosophique de Socrate à travers Aristote jusqu'aux Stoïciens ne désigne pas simplement l'accumulation de connaissances mais l'intégration de la connaissance dans un mode de vie cohérent qui inclut de savoir comment affronter l'adversité la mort l'injustice et l'incertitude avec équanimité que la tradition philosophique distingue constamment la sagesse de la simple habileté de l'érudition ou de l'expertise technique en la fondant plutôt dans la connaissance de soi la vertu et l'orientation vers ce qui importe véritablement.
